about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, an established organisation within the automotive industry in Gżira, for an experienced and proactive Facilities, Maintenance and Health & Safety Manager to oversee its facilities, maintenance operations, workplace safety and sustainability initiatives.

You will make sure buildings, infrastructure and facilities across multiple sites remain safe, efficient, compliant and well maintained. The role covers managing maintenance operations, supervising the Facilities and Sustainability Executive, the Health & Safety Officer and maintenance staff, overseeing budgets and contractors, and leading the organisation's Health & Safety and sustainability work.

It suits a manager with at least three years of experience in a similar role and strong leadership, organisational and problem-solving skills. The position is full-time and on-site with a competitive salary.
responsibilities: Oversee the maintenance and upkeep of buildings, infrastructure, plant and equipment across all sites (excluding workshop equipment)
Supervise the Facilities and Sustainability Executive, Health & Safety Officer and maintenance staff, allocating workload and managing performance
Plan and coordinate routine, preventive and long-term maintenance schedules
Source, negotiate with and manage contractors and service providers for quality, compliance and cost effectiveness
Manage facilities and maintenance budgets, monitor expenditure and report variances to senior management
Coordinate building projects, renovations, site improvements and office relocations
Ensure building services, including water, heating and electrical systems, are maintained and faults resolved promptly
Develop, implement and improve Health & Safety policies, procedures and emergency evacuation plans
Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety, environmental and other regulatory requirements
Oversee risk assessments, hazard identification, safety inspections, audits, equipment testing and corrective actions
Supervise investigations of accidents, incidents and near-misses and make sure preventive measures are implemented
Maintain Health & Safety documentation, including risk assessments, accident records, inspection reports and training logs
Organise Health & Safety training, employee inductions and toolbox talks for employees and contractors
Develop and implement sustainability initiatives on waste management, energy conservation and environmental impact
Work with other departments to promote sustainable practices and a strong safety culture, and recommend improvements
